title: A/R Collection: without AP/AR Data access there is no credit term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose custom role has "Reports → Page Access" and the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch off.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-04 No Terms User.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an overdue invoice, a phone number and a credit term.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-04 Hidden Term with credit term Net 30.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with only {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read {Customer-A}'s group row.
  2. Download the PDF from the ⋯ menu and read {Customer-A}'s line.
  3. Download the CSV and read its heading row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the phone shows; no credit term and no "Credit term:" label.
  • Step 2: the phone shows; no credit term.
  • Step 3: a "Phone" column after "Customer", and no "Credit term" column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S9-N2: “A user without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' sees no credit term on screen, none in the PDF, and no Credit term column in the CSV.”
  • S3-R8a: “On A/R Collection, every CSV row also carries the customer's "Phone" and, for users with 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Credit term", in columns right after "Customer"; the PDF prints them on each customer's line (Story 9).”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Permissions. Viewing all six reports, and exporting them, is governed by 'Reports → Page Access', unchanged. No new permission is introduced and no existing permission changes. Opening a document from a report uses the permission that already opens that document (see Story 7). The credit term on the A/R Collection call list follows the customer card's rule: only users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch see it, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV (Story 9). Amounts show to everyone who can open the reports, as today and as on Sales By Customer and Inventory Value; 'See Financial Data' does not hide them.”
